text:
After a challenging phase, we are glad to have your long message, and we are sorry for the trouble and frustration you experienced with your recent travel arrangements for your companion animal. We understand that the main concern was the handling of the pet booking and the lack of clear guidance when you needed quick answers, and that is not the level of care we want associated with Aurelia Skyways.

I have reviewed the case notes with our team and checked the handoff points where the confusion likely started. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is meant to give concise, kind, and actionable support, and we also share practical instructions with crews so that everyone is working from the same understanding. When that chain breaks down, travelers should not have to carry the burden of sorting it out alone.

I want to reassure you that your feedback has been taken seriously. We have already reminded the desk staff to keep communication simple and to confirm the key pet travel details more clearly before departure. We are also reinforcing the habit of checking special assistance notes early, so situations involving pets are handled with more care and less back and forth at the airport.

If you are still traveling with us, we would be glad to help you prepare the next step with steadier support. Please send us the basic details of your trip and your pet needs, and we will do our best to keep the process calm and straightforward. We cannot undo the inconvenience you faced, but we can work to make the next experience much better.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and for staying patient while we looked into it. We appreciate the chance to improve, and we are sorry that your trust was tested in this way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
